teams.synopsis: The drop from 1 to 5 last week was a mistake and an overreaction — poised for a great second half.
teams.blurb: The drop from 1 to 5 last week was a mistake and an overreaction. Brandon's team is poised for a great 2nd half of the 2024 season, with virtually no weak spots on the roster... my prediction at this point? Brandon v. Max championship.

teams.synopsis: Not at the top this week, but still capable of dropping 150+ any given week — a solid flex piece could lock in a championship spot.
teams.blurb: Don't be fooled — just because he isn't at the top this week doesn't mean he isn't capable of dropping 150+ any given week. If the team can secure a solid and reliable flex, then it'll most certainly be a lock to make the championship.

teams.synopsis: Moves to 3-4 with a Week 7 win even with most of the lineup on bye — a hot streak could push this team to a top record.
teams.blurb: Moves to 3-4 with a win in Week 7, even though most of his lineup was on bye. Similar to Quin's team, the record doesn't look crazy now, but a streak of good weeks can push this team to a top record come playoffs.

teams.synopsis: Deserves more respect than it gets — projected for 126.5 in Week 8, with Pickens getting a QB upgrade in Russ.
teams.blurb: A team that deserves more respect than it gets, Silence is projected for 126.5 in Week 8. <mark class="hl-player">Pickens</mark> gets an upgrade with <mark class="hl-player">Russ</mark> as the quarterback, and the rest of the team is very good if healthy. Quin is a darkhorse to finish top 3.

teams.synopsis: A nail-biting loss to Max, but the team should keep winning and finish as a top team regardless.
teams.blurb: A nail-biting loss in Week 7 to Max, but I don't think it matters. The team will continue to win games in the next 7 weeks and will most likely finish as a top team. As long as injuries stay away, <mark class="hl-player">TFR</mark> will be great for the foreseeable future.

teams.synopsis: The Mike Evans injury hurts, but Tua's return lines up perfectly with a healthy Waddle.
teams.blurb: <mark class="hl-player">Mike Evans</mark> injury just sucks, but at least <mark class="hl-player">Tua</mark> is coming back just in time for Anthony to play <mark class="hl-player">Waddle</mark>. This will be the first week we truly get to see the team fully complete with no byes — time to see what they can do.

teams.synopsis: A 5-2 record with one of the best WR/RB duos in the league — a top-5 finish wouldn't be shocking.
teams.blurb: Again, this team is so sneaky. 5-2 record with one of the best WR and RB duos in the league, <mark class="hl-player">KW3</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Chase</mark>. Don't be surprised if this team has a great 2nd half of the season and reaches top 5 at some point.

teams.synopsis: Vibes at an all-time low after giving away a winnable game — needs a bounce back or things get grim.
teams.blurb: I'm disgusted with this squad, vibes are at an all-time low. That was our game to lose, and we just gave up. There better be a bounce back in Week 8 or things will get grim.

teams.synopsis: A Week 7 win, but still a lot to prove before getting back into the top 7.
teams.blurb: Is Mike Andrews back?? Despite a win in Week 7, this team still has a lot to prove until it can get back into the top 7. If the team continues to increase production, a return to form could be coming.

teams.synopsis: Back-to-back wins and 8th in points per game — a real comeback brewing from an almost-lifeless squad.
teams.blurb: Could we be seeing a comeback from the almost-lifeless squad? Back-to-back wins and 8th in points per game. Big matchup against Ben this week — a loss would put him back into contention for last, but a win would push him toward playoffs.

teams.synopsis: A 2-5 record after a massive loss, but the team still looks capable if things break right in the second half.
teams.blurb: Despite the massive loss and the 2-5 record, the team still looks capable of contending for playoffs if things go right in the 2nd half of the season. Still, WRs are not proven and <mark class="hl-player">LaPorta</mark> has continued to stink.

teams.synopsis: Not back on track — Godwin's incredible run ended with a season-ending injury.
teams.blurb: Not back on track. <mark class="hl-player">Godwin</mark> was incredible until the season-ending injury :( Gonna be tough to make a playoff push, but definitely possible.

teams.synopsis: Injuries have stung, but the team could be back to full strength this week — the WRs remain the weak link.
teams.blurb: Injuries stink... but the team might be back to full strength this week. QB, RBs, and TE are great for a playoff team... but the wide receivers are gross.

teams.synopsis: Still winless after 7 weeks — the Aiyuk season-ending injury makes a bad situation worse.
teams.blurb: Still winless 7 weeks in... brutal. <mark class="hl-player">Carmine</mark> picking up a win in Week 7 doesn't help — big matchup this week. <mark class="hl-player">Aiyuk</mark> out for the season makes things even worse.
